answer: An agent network resists Sybil attacks using proofs of space-time. Nodes prove active membership by resolving randomized lookup challenges against committed storage plots. An attacker deploying an ocean of synthetic nodes incurs the scarce capital cost of dedicated disk capacity, triggering a severe hardware cost spiral. However, when time-space trade-offs reach their optimization zenith, adversaries using fast GPUs can dynamically compute solutions without dedicating real storage.
